sloka: स तु वैश्रवणस्तत्र तपोवनगतस्तदा ।अवर्धताहुतिहुतो महातेजा यथानलः ।। ७.३.९ ॥
transliteration: sa tu vaiśravaṇastatra tapovanagatastadā ।avardhatāhutihuto mahātejā yathānalaḥ ।। 7.3.9 ॥

translations.english: Then, Vaishravana, having gone to the hermitage, grew there, greatly effulgent, like a fire nourished by oblations.
